title: NIST CAISSI opens comment on draft practices for evaluating superintelligence-driven uplift
summary: One evaluator item and no new vulnerability, incident or capability item. NIST's CAISSI posted draft SP 2400-801 on evaluating uplift from superintelligent systems, open for comment until 22 February 2027.

items.title: NIST CAISSI opens comment on draft practices for evaluating superintelligence-driven uplift
items.summary: NIST's Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (CAISSI) posted a draft, NIST SP 2400-801, on practices for evaluating uplift from superintelligent (SI) systems, with public comment open until February 22, 2027.
items.note: Taken from the news listing on the CAISSI hub page; the notice's own page could not be fetched, so the draft's contents were not read.
